corpus:
The valve leaks at night. Dale mends the valve; the valve holds.
Water runs downhill, and the javelina don't wait. Don't let the gate hinge fail!
Red rock dust coats everything. Everything settles by morning.
Dale watches the water. The morning holds what the night loosened.
